entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • It looks like some consumers of IsContainedInNamespace helper fail to check expected arity of the type #81345
  • Feature 'Diagnostic analyzer runner' is currently unavailable due to an internal error. #81335
  • Auto complete doesn't include items from unimported namespaces #81333
  • #If...Then...#Else Directives don't adjust when changing from Debug to Release and vise verse #81332
  • Issue with CS8604 reported using property with lazy field keyword initialization #81331

Closed

  • Extensions members aren't shown correctly in Visual Studio 2026 #81010
  • Parentheses don't automatically close when adding a new parameter to the end of the method call #79586
  • CSharpAddParameterCodeFixProvider #79364
  • Partial Property on class with Primary Constructor shows IDE error CS0229 but compiles fine. #76794
    Backlog
  • Latest 4.14.0 of Public API Analyzers seem to have an issue "Fixing" record types #79152
    Backlog

    Backlog
  • enclose parentheses issues #78053
  • Vsix explorer does not show code issues in updated Microsoft.CodeAnalysis #76589
    Backlog
  • Copy/Paste does not preserve semantics when multiple types with the same name exist #72122
  • Investigate why new rename UI is causing completion tests to fail in CI #63576
  • '&method group' does not work with implicit operators of the exact unmanaged delegate type #81234
    18.3
  • It looks like `CheckUnderspecifiedGenericExtension` is going to crash for an extension block declared in a namespace #80829
    18.3
  • CS1734 breaks paramrefs with C# 14 extension blocks #81217
    18.3
  • Add friendly display of inline array instances in the debugger #68983
    Backlog
  • Introduce Constant IDE feature doesn't work with extension blocks #81337
  • "Use null propagation" doesn't show up for compound assignments #81322
  • IDE0032 code fixer produces invalid code for static field assigned in constructor #81320
  • Extension members not suggested by IntelliSense when "Show items from unimported namespaces" is enabled #80561
    Backlog
  • VS 2026 Insiders - Feature 'Diagnostic analyzer runner' is currently unavailable due to an internal error. #81336
  • Nullability and entity framework queries requires messy query annotations #81334
  • Expression interpreter bug in .NET 10 #81329
  • Extension property triggers CA1034 (Nested types should not be visible) #81330
  • Error CS1744 when parameter is named `value` in extension in another project #81251
    18.3
  • Crash using extension property in expression evaluator #81171
    18.3
  • Async-streams: improve diagnostic when missing `async` keyword #31113
